newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices up on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices up on fresh buying.

text.p: India's castorseed December delivery rose on Monday against lower opening levels on hectic speculative buying, dealers said.
Castorseed December delivery finished at 1,139/1,140 rupees per quintal from its week-end close of 1,126/1,128 rupees.
"The monsoon is playing hide-and-seek in producing centres and the market fears a lower crop," a dealer said.
Groundnut oil moved up to 426/428 per 10 kg from 425/426 rupees on fresh physical buying for approaching festivals. In Rajkot, spot oil gained 15/20 rupees at 680/685 rupees per 15 kg.
